intro.en: Flame-retardant cable limits flame propagation under a defined test arrangement.
intro.zh: 阻燃电线电缆在规定试验排列下限制火焰蔓延。

knowledge.en: Single-cable, bunched-cable, fire-resistance, smoke and halogen tests answer different questions.
knowledge.zh: 单根、成束、耐火、烟密度与无卤试验回答不同问题。

notes.en: Provide exact fire-test method, installation, construction, marking and evidence.
notes.zh: 请提供准确燃烧试验方法、安装、结构、印字与证据。

delivery.en: Release records the exact cable identity and supporting fire-test evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含准确线缆身份与支持燃烧试验证据。

subtitle.en: Specify the fire test, cable arrangement and acceptance evidence
subtitle.zh: 明确燃烧试验、敷设方式与验收证据

lead.en: Flame-retardant is a defined test result, not a universal fire claim.
lead.zh: 阻燃是规定试验结果，不是通用防火声明。
